record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Describe the metric approximation property for the Banach operator ideal P of absolutely summing operators. More explicitly, characterize when a Banach space X has the property that for every Banach space Y and every absolutely summing operator T:X -> Y, there is a net of finite-rank operators S_alpha on X converging to the identity uniformly on compact subsets of X and satisfying limsup_alpha ||T S_alpha||_P <= ||T||_P.

evidence.quote: we say that X has the MAP for A if for every Banach space Y and every operator T ∈ A(X, Y ), there exists a net (Sα) ⊂ F(X, X) such that Sα → IX uniformly on compact subsets of X and lim supα kT SαkA ≤ kTkA.
Problem 5.1 (cf. Problem 5.3 in [4]). Describe the MAP for P.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{P}$ denote the Banach operator ideal of absolutely summing operators between Banach spaces, equipped with its usual ideal norm $\|\cdot\|_{\mathcal{P}}$ (an operator $T:X\to Y$ is absolutely summing if there is a constant $C$ such that for every finite family $(x_i)\subset X$, $\sum_i \|Tx_i\| \le C \sup_{\|x^*\|\le 1}\sum_i |x^*(x_i)|$, and $\|T\|_{\mathcal{P}}$ is the least such $C$). For a Banach space $X$, let $\mathcal{F}(X,X)$ denote the space of finite-rank operators on $X$.

Say that a Banach space $X$ has the metric approximation property (MAP) with respect to $\mathcal{P}$ if for every Banach space $Y$ and every absolutely summing operator $T \in \mathcal{P}(X,Y)$ there exists a net $(S_\alpha)\subset \mathcal{F}(X,X)$ such that:
(i) $S_\alpha \to \mathrm{id}_X$ uniformly on compact subsets of $X$, and
(ii) $\limsup_\alpha \|T S_\alpha\|_{\mathcal{P}} \le \|T\|_{\mathcal{P}}$.

Problem: Give an intrinsic characterization of those Banach spaces $X$ which possess the MAP with respect to $\mathcal{P}$.
artifact.status_search_result: No characterization of the metric approximation property with respect to the ideal of absolutely summing operators appears in the literature. Related work (e.g., approximation properties determined by operator ideals, right/left approximation properties, and the p-approximation property) treats general operator ideals but does not provide an intrinsic description for the absolutely summing case, which remains an explicitly posed open problem.

status_evidence.title: The approximation properties determined by operator ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Studies approximation properties determined by Banach operator ideals; results on duality and passage between dual and underlying space.
status_evidence.claim: General framework exists but no specific intrinsic characterization for the absolutely summing ideal is given.

status_evidence.title: Weaker relatives of the bounded approximation property
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses variants of approximation properties associated with operator ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the topic is actively studied; the MAP for P is not characterized.
